body:
Fourth sweep: the statistical claims. No defects found - this one is entirely confirmatory, and it is the strongest evidence yet that the engine is sound.

UNBIASEDNESS HOLDS. Pure noise, 20 features, 4 runs, 3000 replicates:

  signed        mean +0.00102   z = +0.36
  coherent      mean -0.00085   z = -1.16
  configuration mean +0.00180   z = +0.56
  total         mean +0.00095   z = +0.29

All within 1.2 standard errors of zero. introduction.Rmd:126-127 says cross-products are unbiased around zero; they are.

AND THE NUMBER THAT MAKES THE CASE FOR THE PACKAGE'S MOST CONTESTED DESIGN CHOICE:

  52.4 percent of total estimates are below zero under the null.

An unbiased estimator centred at zero must be negative about half the time. Truncating at zero would bias every null voxel upward. That is the entire argument for retaining negatives, and it is one line of simulation that appears nowhere in the documentation despite the policy being asserted in five separate places.

THE DECOMPOSITION MEANS WHAT THE PROSE SAYS. Planting each kind of effect and reading the split:

  purely univariate effect, every feature shifted by 1
     coherent 1.0060   configuration 0.0131    ratio 77 : 1
  purely multivariate effect, exactly zero-mean pattern
     coherent 0.0008   configuration 1.0393    ratio 1339 : 1

Both components recover the planted magnitude on their own side. So total = coherent + configuration is not only an exact algebraic identity - already verified at a difference of literally zero - it separates the thing the vignette claims it separates.

Determinism confirmed: identical seeds, bitwise identical totals.

WHERE THIS LEAVES THE WORKSTREAM. Thirty-two beads filed. A reader of this board could reasonably conclude the package is in trouble, and that conclusion would be wrong. Verified so far, all by execution or hand-computation rather than by reading: the estimator is unbiased; the decomposition is interpretable and recovers ground truth; six documented mathematical laws hold, one exactly and two at machine epsilon; the unification claim is true on both halves; rdm agrees with hand computation bitwise; the conservative total is invariant across every spatial scale; validation refuses bad input correctly and with good messages almost everywhere.

Every defect I have filed is in the SURFACE - names, error messages, documentation, one type seam, two silent behaviours. None is in the mathematics.

Practical consequence, and it is the most useful thing from this sweep: the three simulations above are exactly the missing 'why negative values are not a bug' vignette that bd-01KZYARD5697TRN2Q3S0E153BM identified. Plant a univariate effect and watch coherent light up; plant a pattern and watch configuration light up; run the null and watch half the estimates go negative. Three chunks, and they make the most abstract part of the framework concrete. Noted on that bead.
